description: Link or unlink entities and regions to state-memory task nodes, or extract a goal-relevant spatial slice. Actions: link, unlink, get_context. link/unlink mutate association rows only. get_context is read-only. Returns {ok, action, links[]|context}. Use link_to_goal instead of record_outcome when associating entities with state-memory task nodes rather than recording physical movement deltas.

action.description: Action to perform: "link" (default), "unlink", or "get_context" to retrieve goal-relevant spatial slice

current_agent_position.description: Current agent position for get_context action

max_entities.description: Maximum entities to return for get_context action (default: 20)

min_clearance.description: Minimum clearance distance required to satisfy the goal

radius.description: Proximity radius around agent for get_context action (default: 30)

relationship.description: Role of entity relative to goal (default: target)

success_region.description: Spatial bounding volume region defining goal arrival

target_entity_id.description: Direct target entity ID for navigation and clearance tracking

name: link_to_goal
